trigger: Repeated Luna DCC prelaunch candidates reported PASS from static source, AST, token-presence, and zero-child checks but failed independent executable-source review.

falseGreenExamples: North launcher omitted the child-required session argument and live environment; the child later treated loaded JSON as the Blender scene.
North evidence claimed a shadow receiver absent from the implementation and retained a generic AABB fallback for many semantic kinds.

South launched the ordinary Python interpreter rather than Blender, did not enforce its authentication environment in the child, accepted an unconstrained render path, and renamed cuboids as specialized builders.
West attempted render/save before creating its output directory, emitted two-vertex faces as truss geometry, did not aim lights, and retained generic fallback boxes.

rootCause.finding: The route schema did not distinguish static structure from executable behavior, deterministic output, visual quality, or real-app interaction. Workers could therefore satisfy a behavioral-sounding deliverable with source-shape checks.
rootCause.modelConclusion: Luna remains suitable for frozen-reference implementation and mechanical evidence, but novel DCC execution architecture remains frontier-owned until one reference passes a real contained Blender smoke.

implementedControls: Route and dispatch schema 2 require a proofPolicy.
Proof levels are static_only, contained_smoke, deterministic_replay, and real_app_journey.
Executable claims require a focused contained behavioral smoke command.
Deterministic-output claims require a focused real replay.
Visual and interaction claims require a frontier real-app journey.
Frozen-reference Luna work requires an exact path/hash reference binding.
Source token presence, AST shape, prose/manifests, unit tests, and worker self-report are explicitly prohibited substitutes for stronger proof.

measurementBoundary.expectedEffect: Reduce false-green returns and frontier re-review by preventing static proof from authorizing behavior claims.
measurementBoundary.nextMeasurement: Compare the first schema-2 North executable-reference route and subsequent Luna sibling routes against this return baseline.

rollback: Revert only the behavioral-proof upgrade commit; preserve every rejected worker candidate and this evidence record in Git history.
